title: Coordinate projections of Hⁿ-null sets are Lebesgue-null (parent step 3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let I : Fin n → Fin P be injective, and let C ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) satisfy μHE[n](C) = 0. Let q : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ (Euclid n) be the coordinate projection q(x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => x (I k)), i.e. q(x)_k = x_{I(k)}. Then the image q(C) has Lebesgue measure zero: volume(q(C)) = 0 (volume on EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin P) (C : Set (Euclid P)), Function.Injective I → μHE[n] C = 0 → volume ((fun x : Euclid P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => x (I k)) : Euclid n)) '' C) = 0
